caption: The drawing depicts a colorful statue of a standing figure, dressed in a bright yellow tunic decorated with sun motifs and bordered with patterns in blue, green, and red. The figure wears yellow boots and a cape in shades of red, with green and red feathers attached at the shoulders and to a headdress made of yellow fabric, adorned with a band and upright green and red feathers. The figure holds a dark blue book in its left hand and raises its right hand, grasping an object that resembles a comb or brush, colored in brown and black. Another smaller figure, dressed in a red garment, is positioned on the left shoulder of the main figure, with its left arm around the main figure's neck. The statue stands on a rectangular green pedestal. The background is plain, off-white with no other objects visible.
title: Cigar Store Indian
